featureDefinitions.label: Daily steps (period mean)
featureDefinitions.definition: Mean steps while awake in source feature window.

featureDefinitions.label: Sleep duration (recent mean)
featureDefinitions.definition: Mean nightly minutes asleep over source last 4 days, divided by 60.

featureDefinitions.label: Weekday sleep efficiency
featureDefinitions.definition: Weekday mean asleep/in-bed ratio multiplied by 100.

featureDefinitions.label: Sleep onset (adjusted hour)
featureDefinitions.definition: Source adjusted sleep-start hour; 28 means 04:00 next day. Linear shifted scale, not ordinary clock hour.

featureDefinitions.label: Short sleep nights (source week)
featureDefinitions.definition: Number of nights with less than 5 hours asleep in source last 7 days.

featureDefinitions.label: Active days (source week)
featureDefinitions.definition: Days with >10,000 steps in source last 7 days.
